conclusions.subject: contract
conclusions.text: The shared Contract is complete and faithful to the frozen materials. Identity: one task, Name reuses the题目名, and no split is warranted - the entry's k%128 check and its route/tile choices are implementation restrictions, not task boundaries. Interface: input.py returns exactly the ten registered parameters, so Input is neither short nor expanded; tuples a/b are atomic python_tuple inputs whose members a_q/a_sf/b_q/b_sf are structurally registered in Operand_layout with the shapes and dtypes the entry itself validates (fp8_e4m3fn payload, int8-viewed packed weights, fp32 scales, bf16 d, int32 masked_m); recipe uses nullable+default None and recipe_a/recipe_b use python_none, matching the signature defaults, and Compute states these parameters do not affect the result, which reference.py confirms because it never reads them. Math: exact decode of E4M3 payloads and 2^i UE8M0 block-32 scales - the power-of-two domain comes from the encoder's clamp(-126,127) in input.py, so it is an external construction fact and also makes the FP32 products exact on the constructed domain (the reachable exponents are far inside FP32 range, so no overflow caveat is needed); low nibble = even k, high nibble = odd k; the signed 16-entry E2M1 table with c=8 -> -0 matches the reference LUT exactly; FP32 dot products over k_dim with unspecified summation order (the reference's 64-row blocking does not change values and allow_tf32=False makes it true FP32); y defined only on active rows with empty experts defining no product; bf16(y) written in place. Domain: taken from the task-declared shape_range material (group_count {8,16,32,64}, capacity multiples of 128 in 128..1024, the five (n_dim,k_dim) pairs, 0 <= masked_m <= capacity), which also makes k_dim/32 and k_dim/2 integral; shape_cases confirms all-empty, mixed partial/full/empty and zero-payload workloads. Side effects: only d mutates (mutates_inputs=[d], no scratch), storage outside the d buffer is sentinel-protected, the whole d buffer is the permitted write region and the compared region is the active prefix - metadata's region sentence and input.py's writable_views/observable_inputs hooks reconcile in favour of the operative hook, whose own comment states padding writes have no numerical contract, and that is what Output_writeback records. The call returns None. Reference: reference.py::Model.forward is an independent FP32 oracle with no divergence from Compute, so omitting Gap is correct, and the production deep_gemm entry named in metadata is properly not used as the reference. Tolerance: d_out keeps atol=0.01, rtol=0.05, max_mismatch_fraction=0.0 verbatim as a labelled source record; I searched the whole operator package for relative_to/comparator/mismatch_fraction/rmse/allclose/tolerance and only metadata's thresholds and CERTIFIED_BEST's 'comparator/tolerances unchanged' exist, so no default interpretation is applied and comparisons is empty. Execution: thread/warp/cta/cluster are each source-grounded (THREADS=256 with 8 specialized warps; tcgen05.alloc.cta_group::1 plus the TMEM accumulator/SF budget for CTA-scope tmem; dynamic extern __shared__ for smem; __cluster_dims__(2,1,1) with mapa.shared::cluster and cluster-scope mbarrier arrive for cluster, which g_use_2sm=0 keeps out of the default build), they register register/smem/tmem with their scopes, and they assert no device capacity or launch limit.

conclusions.subject: coverage
conclusions.text: Each required evidence category covers its bound entry plus the needed call chain. implementation: candidate/solution.py::Model.forward (signature and defaults, tuple unpack, _validate formats and shapes) extended into candidate/kernel.cu only as far as the Execution registration requires (THREADS/warp roles, TMEM budget and tcgen05.alloc, dynamic smem, __cluster_dims__ with mapa and cluster-scope arrive, and the default g_use_2sm=0). io: metadata.json description plus benchmark_contract (mutates_inputs, defined region, alias) and correctness_tolerances. input: input.py::_make_inputs -> make -> matrix/quantize/guarded and the writable_views/observable_inputs hooks, including the UE8M0 exponent clamp and the nibble packing order. reference: reference.py::Model.forward -> expected -> activation_operand/weight_operand. acceptance: CERTIFIED_BEST.json, which publishes certification status and 'comparator/tolerances unchanged' but no numerical criteria. scope: shape_range.json value sets and cross_field_invariants, plus shape_cases.json cases 1 (all experts empty), 3 (zero distribution) and 4 (mixed 1024/511/0/257). I read the full current root.yaml (all 120 lines, including the untouched hardware placeholders and DESIGN skeleton), confirmed root.yaml is the only node so no shared Name/Describe sync applies, and ran the frozen check helper once. No GPU, hardware or wiki material was used, per the P1 extraction exemption.

conclusions.subject: document_self_contained
conclusions.text: root.yaml's P1 content stands alone. Every input, output, axis name (expert/row/out/k/block/packed_k) and runtime scale (group_count/capacity/n_dim/k_dim) is introduced where first used, with the scale relations and divisibility conditions given in the first Math step that uses them; the tuple members a_q/a_sf/b_q/b_sf and the intermediates av/bv/y are registered with meaning, shape and dtype; the two ref: targets (a_q.shape, d.shape) resolve inside the same Contract and are used only where the axis sets genuinely match; the E2M1 magnitude table, the sign rule and the nibble order are defined at first use, so a reader can write a naive reference without opening the source. The d/d_out identity is stated in both meanings, so the renamed output is locatable against the acceptance output d. The Tolerance entry states its own limits (formula/basis absent, no defaults) instead of relying on an outside comparator or on a prior receipt, and nothing in the Contract depends on the Design draft or on historical explanation.

conclusions.subject: document_layering
conclusions.text: Layering is correct. The Contract contains only task-level facts: the quantization group length (32), stored-value decode, mask semantics, FP32 accumulation with the order explicitly left open, the bf16 narrowing conversion and the write/side-effect boundary. The source's implementation restrictions stay out - k%128, the contiguity/CUDA checks in _validate, BM/BN/BK/STAGES constants, the 8-warp role split and the expected_m<=16 route gate are not promoted into algorithm preconditions, and the declared domain comes from the task-side shape_range material rather than from what the candidate supports. expected_m is recorded as advisory with its construction formula, so no scheduling semantics leak upward. In the hardware区 only the authorized minimal Execution registration is filled, each entry citing its source basis rather than asserting a device capability or capacity, and Device/Architecture/Feature/Stack/Wiki keep the starter placeholders. DESIGN is still the starter skeleton, so no P2 mechanism choice or root representative is pre-empted.

conclusions.subject: document_consistency
conclusions.text: One coherent task is expressed across the whole file. Shapes and formulas use the same axis names and scales end to end (a_q [expert,row,k] with av[e,i,j]; b_q [expert,out,packed_k] with c[e,n,j] indexed by j < k_dim; b_sf/bv over out and k; y ref:d.shape with y[e,i,n]), and the declared k_dim values make both k_dim/32 and k_dim/2 integral as Operand_layout claims. masked_m's range 0 <= masked_m <= capacity is consistent with the capacity domain, with the empty-expert branch in Masked_grouped_product and with fixed cases 1/4/7. Input d and Output d_out are the same buffer with the identity stated in both meanings, and the writeback formula, the padding sentence and the outside-storage sentence together cover active rows, inactive rows and the sentinel guard without contradiction; the permission to overwrite padding matches observable_inputs while the compared region matches metadata's defined region. Tolerance covers exactly the one registered output and its key matches that output name. Every input-derived case (all experts empty, all rows active, partial prefixes, zero payloads) is defined, and the nullable recipe branch is resolved by the statement that these parameters do not affect the result.

conclusions.subject: document_relevance
conclusions.text: Only necessary content is retained. There are no process notes, to-dos, revision history, validation status, performance figures or design rationale anywhere in the file; the certified latency data and the source's experiment commentary are correctly left out. The brief 'construction passes ...' notes record the actual call values of parameters that provably do not affect the result, which is what lets Compute dismiss them; the declared request domain is needed to bound the sizes used in every formula; and the Tolerance entry keeps the declared thresholds plus an explicit statement of what is absent rather than filling the field with assumed defaults. The block length 32 is defined once in Operand_layout prose and then applied directly in the k_dim/32 shape expressions and floor(j/32) index terms, so the format constant has a single unambiguous source and cannot drift; naming it as a Constant would be optional compression, not missing information. Names are plain and follow the source vocabulary (a_q/a_sf/b_q/b_sf, masked_m, capacity, d_out).

issues.detail: The frozen package declares only local thresholds for the single output. metadata.json benchmark_contract.correctness_tolerances.default gives atol=0.01, rtol=0.05, max_mismatch_fraction=0.0, and the acceptance entry CERTIFIED_BEST.json records only 'same instance/address across existing seeds; comparator/tolerances unchanged' with engine/checker hashes. Searching the whole operator package for relative_to, comparator, mismatch_fraction, rmse, allclose, tolerance, atol and rtol returns nothing else, so no element formula combining atol and rtol, no relative-error basis, no comparison precision, no normalization, no non-finite handling and no check routing is provided. Per the DOC1 acceptance-source-record rule the Tolerance.d_out entry keeps the declared thresholds verbatim and states that the formula/basis is absent and that the default interpretation is not applied; the compared region (active prefix d[e,:masked_m[e],:]) is independently defined in Compute Output_writeback from metadata.json's defined_outputs region and input.py's observable_inputs hook, so the gap does not leave the output semantics undefined. This does not block P1: task math, IO, side effects and the reference entry are fully determined, fixed-implementation extraction does not require reproducing the external comparator or running GPU acceptance, and the record claims no numerical guarantee. Related source wording, already reconciled and not a gap: metadata's region sentence says all remaining logical storage is unchanged while input.py's operative observable_inputs hook compares only the active prefix and states a native masked GEMM may write capacity padding; the Contract follows the operative hook, and writable_views (whole d) plus the guarded sentinel backing (outside d) fix the permitted write region.
issues.recovery_condition: The task side supplies or confirms the full comparator definition (element formula, relative-error basis, comparison precision, non-finite handling and the exact checked region). Until then Tolerance.d_out must remain a labelled source record, must be carried into delivery, and must not be used as an error budget for new designs or optimization.

conclusions.subject: mechanisms
conclusions.text: 机制概览我沿固定入口到输出独立复核，全部成立且无遗漏。提交身份：Model.forward 每次调用只有一次 ctypes fmggm_launch，在 PyTorch 当前 stream 上启动一个 kernel（默认宏下 FMGGM_MAIN_KERNEL=fmggm_kernel_dr，grid=num_sms、block=256、dynamic smem=sizeof(SharedStorage)），返回 None、结果就地写进调用方 d；无库/DSL/Torch 回退、无 graph 捕获、f32→UE8M0 融合在被测 kernel 内，NCU 的 kernel_counts 恒为 [1,1,1,1,1] 且只出现 fmggm_kernel_dr 与 fmggm_kernelT<(int)16,(int)5>。主计算：swap-AB 的 tcgen05.mma.cta_group::1.kind::mxf8f6f4.block_scale——adesc 指向 sm.b（权重 E2M1 为 MMA A、idesc 的 umma_m=128）、bdesc 指向 sm.a（激活 E4M3 为 MMA B）、idesc_n 由 eff>>3 填入故 N=align16(effective_m)，每 stage K=128 拆 4 条 UMMA_K=32，权重 SF 占 NW_SUB=2 组 4 列、激活 SF 占 ceil(N/128)=1 组 4 列，accumulate 只在 (kb,t)=(0,0) 为 0，最后一条 k-block 的 tcgen05.commit 触发 tmem_full。输出形成：TMEM→寄存器→bf16→stmatrix.trans→单缓冲 8KB cd→named barrier→128 线程 4 趟 16B st.global 直写扁平 [E*M,N] 的 d，DINTER 下一个 si 同时 drain j1/j0（16 行×256 列连续）。工作分配：持久 masked-grouped 调度，扁平位置 iter*num_sms+worker_id 经 expert 累积 m-block 走查与 g_group 子组 swizzle 解码成 (expert, m-block, n-pair)，m-blocks=ceil(masked_m[e]/BM)、空 expert 无 tile，STAIL 在 1<=R=T mod num_sms<=num_sms/2 时把最后 R 个 pair-tile 拆成 2R 个单 j 半 tile（写回侧对死半 tile 在等 tmem_full 之前就 continue），各角色各自走同一位置序列、无跨 warp 广播。主协作：8 warp 专用角色 + 4 深 smem ring + 五个屏障，计数与到达者我逐个对到 mbar_init 与各 arrive 点：full=65（1 次 expect_tx + warp2/warp3 各 32 lane）、sf_full=1、empty=1（由 UMMA 的 commit 到达，界定槽内 smem 读完成）、tmem_full=1、tmem_empty=128（4 个写回 warp 全 lane）；ACC_STAGES=1 故 MMA 在下一 tile 首条 UMMA 前等这一次释放；全空输入在 warp2 的 tmem_alloc 之前直接退出。pack warp 的读-等-写顺序（先等 sf_full 把 f32 读进寄存器、再等 empty 才就地覆写为 UE8M0、fence.proxy.async 后到达 full）与 pack_sf4 只取指数字节一致。据此认可草案核心判断：三个几何实例共用同一套主计算/输出形成/工作分配/主协作，只有 cta_group::2 的 2-CTA cluster kernel 重新贯通了这四者。

conclusions.subject: root_choice
conclusions.text: root 选 fmggm_bodyT<BMV=128,STG=4>（fmggm_kernel_dr 的 else 分支）是真实源码实例、不是拼接的虚拟基线，plan_draft 的实例串我逐项核对无误：BM=FMGGM_BMV=128、BN=128、BK=128（BK256=0）、UMMAS_PER_STAGE=4、SF_SUB=1、N_B_PER_STAGE=2（DUALN=1,N_B=2）、STAGES=4、ACC_STAGES=1、THREADS=256、SharedStorage=SharedStorageT<128,4>，启动为 grid=dim3(g_num_sms)/block=dim3(THREADS)/dynamic smem=sizeof(SharedStorage)/调用方 stream。选择理由有据：它是文件作用域几何与全部布局常量的基准值，接口最清楚、便于理解和比较；源码明确 -DFMGGM_DROUTE=0 逐位恢复认证的单几何构建，且 BMV 引入的每处替换在 128 都是恒等式，故该几何本身在完整声明域上成立、宽/解码只是性能取值而非正确性前提（源码亦称两个 body 都是 oracle-clean、nothing changes numerics）；十个固定用例中 6 个（1/2/3/5/6/8）由它直接承担，我按 host 解码门与设备 wide 判据逐个重算归属与草案一致；NCU 的主路由 kernel 名就是 fmggm_kernel_dr，实测 Block (256,1,1)、Grid (148,1,1)，且我按 SharedStorageT<128,4> 逐字段求和（cd 8192 + b 131072 + a 65536 + sfw_raw 16384 + sfa_raw 8192 + 屏障/tmem_base 116）后向上对齐 1024 得 230,400 B、SharedStorageT<16,5> 得 214,016 B，与两条路由在 NCU 中的动态共享内存列吻合，双向印证默认宏组合即被认证与被测的那一份。不选设备路由包装本身（它是两套几何之间的选择公式，按规范不能成为一份 YAML 的内容）、不选宽几何（更复杂但只是同一 body 的参数实例，其 ring 深度 3 是 smem 预算强制的联动而非独立组织）也符合“root 无需最复杂或最通用”的规则。root 自身的 when 与完整 Design 留待 P3，符合 P2 阶段边界，本阶段不批准完整 Design。

conclusions.subject: selection
conclusions.text: 独立认可拟完整集合只含 root 一份（远低于含 root 至多十份的上限），逐项降级判断均成立。宽激活 tile fmggm_bodyT<224,3>：与 root 同一模板实例，四项主机制未变，差额是一个参数（每 tile 激活行数）加可明确说明的联动（ring 深度被两条 static_assert 强制为 3、NSFA_K=2 多一次 UTCCP 与 4 列 TMEM、TMEM 列位随影子常量后移到 j1=224/SFW=448/SFA=456 共 464/512、map_a_wide/map_sfa_wide、TX_SFA 按 224 行、ABOX 多一档、sched.init 收 bm=224 进而 g_group=8、BMSHIFT 与 J0LB 整体关闭），我按 BM=224 重算列位与每 stage 69,632 B 均吻合，故基线主体加差额说明足以表达，记为参数正确。解码 tile fmggm_kernelT<16,5>：同理，差额是 bm=16 引起的 m-block 数与权重重取上界、每 stage 40,960 B/5 深 212,992 B、A 走 map_a16、SFA 槽仍 128 行、独立 cudaFuncSetAttribute，主协作与输出形成不变，记为参数正确。两级几何路由：host 门与设备 blk_ratio 判据都是配置选择，按规范不得以开关/枚举/选择公式留在 YAML，记为一条组合并给出固定用例归属正确；接口相容性有源码依据（路由值是 (masked_m,num_groups) 的纯函数，故 CTA/grid 一致、两 body 的屏障/TMEM/ring 状态不会混用），没有为少建文件拼接不相容机制。fmggm_kernel2sm：确实重新贯通四项主机制（cluster 为一个 256 权重行 tile 的工作归属单位、cta_group::2 UMMA 与 umma_m=256、激活 N 劈分与激活 SF 复制/权重 SF 按 M 劈分、cg2 TMA 把 tx 累计到 leader 的 full(129)、pack warp 远程到达、leader 独占发 MMA、commit 多播、tmem_empty count 8、进出各一次 cluster barrier、每 CTA 存自己 128 列），草案登记为“已研究但未完整展开的独立方案”并给出名称、独特机制、出处、进入条件与被否决的实测理由，明确不交付完整 schema、没有改称参数、也没有占完整名额，符合诚实说明未完整展开的要求；未选入的依据（默认 g_use_2sm=0、只有环境变量 FMGGM_KERNEL=2sm 且 N%256==0、SM 数偶数才启动、源码记录在 L20D 上更慢、认证 NCU 记录里未出现）我逐条核实成立。其余非默认臂的定级也逐条核对：改变生产者/屏障/存储/写回代理/到达规则的记为局部（LDGSF、PKELECT、TMA_STORE、BMERGE、MCAST、PDL/FASTEXIT、J0LB/J0LA/EDR/TJEB/LDBATCH），只改取值或缓存提示的记为参数（BK256、N_B=3、g_group/GG、BMSHIFT/MMC、STAIL 开关、ABOX/EBOX 阶梯、TCP/LEVICT/PROMO/BPF），EXPER/MTR/MTRE 判为诊断臂不构成设计——分类与源码 guard 和自述一致。上轮提出的四处问题已全部修正且未引入新的取舍变化，故本阶段选择予以放行。

conclusions.subject: coverage
conclusions.text: 调查止点有据，不存在会动摇当前选择的未解疑点。我沿固定 host 入口贯通到输出独立核对了：solution.py 的构建/绑定/缓存 key/校验/单次启动与 rc 处理；fmggm_launch 的全部拒绝分支（-10…-13）、num_sms 取得、三处 cudaFuncSetAttribute、g_use_2sm 解析、8 槽 TensorMap+Params 缓存；encode_maps 的六种 A box（BM/16/32/64/8/128）与 wide A、B 的 16U4_ALIGN16B、D 的 {64,16}、SFA/SFB 的 {4,BM}/{4,BN} 与 wide SFA；设备路由包装全文与两个 body 的实例化关系；fmggm_bodyT 的四个角色分支（TMA warp 的 tx 常量与逐 kb 载入、pack warp 的读-等-写顺序与 PKELECT 两种到达、MMA warp 的 DESCROLL 三段循环与 stage 宏、写回的 DINTER 与逐 j 两条路径及 EDR/TMA_STORE 分支）；Scheduler 全文（含 STAIL 与非 STAIL 两个 next()）；SharedStorageT/SharedStorageDec/SharedStorage2 与 TMEM 列预算；2-CTA kernel 全文；全部默认宏、被自动关闭的宏及其 guard（含 DCS/SF_PF 两个无使用点的宏）。材料侧核对了 reference.py 全文、input.py 的编码器与 observable_inputs、metadata.json 的 benchmark_contract 与 tolerances、shape_range.json 的取值域与 cross_field_invariants、shape_cases.json 的 case 0/1/4/7/9（其余用例按同一算式重算）、CERTIFIED_BEST.json 的认证状态、ncu/result.json 的 kernel_counts 与逐 shape kernel 名、ncu/0.csv 与 1.csv 的启动配置与共享内存列。草案自陈的未逐 lane 推导部分（tmem_ld 的 |0x00100000 偏移、STSM 地址的 swizzle 异或、store pass 的 row/chunk 分解，以及 UMMA 的 SF 列组如何被硬件按 n_dim 跨越）确实不影响机制区分与代表选择，已如实限定并写成 P3/P5 线索，符合“不影响当前主张的未读细节如实限定”；待落实四项（root 的 when、g_group 需固定具体值、逐 lane 索引、暂拟对象名）都是本阶段允许的计划与止点。上轮唯一实际覆盖缺口（PKELECT 未登记）本轮已补齐为独立局部条目，覆盖完整。

conclusions.subject: document_self_contained
conclusions.text: 当前产物无需历史上下文即可理解。dispatch.md 的范围段自成脉络：实现范围与提交身份、默认构建即认证构建、主要机制、root 选择与初步承担范围、已研究但未完整展开的独立方案、来源限制七条、待 P3/P4 落实的四项线索，输入/输出/条件/出处均可定位；完整设计表与十五条变体记录都直接链接实际存在的 root.yaml，并用其中的对象名或源码常量（BM、ring 深度、BK/N_B、g_group、STAIL 位置空间、ABOX 取数范围、SF 链、full 计数与到达者、DINTER 写回、每 stage 的 6 条请求、1-CTA ring、启动方式与早退 pass）定位基线，暂拟对象名已明确标注由 P4 对齐，未来内容只以计划形式出现、没有被当作已完成定义或共享证明。本轮新增的「SF 打包到达规则（局部）」三个信息项齐备、基线直接给出 full 的计数构成与到达者，读者不需历史即可理解差额。root.yaml 的 P1 内容同样可独立读懂：十个输入与唯一输出 d_out 的就地关系、四个 Compute 步骤按先定义后使用排列（Operand_layout 引入 a_q/a_sf/b_q/b_sf 与规模，Operand_decode 定义 av/bv，Masked_grouped_product 定义 y，Output_writeback 定义写回区域与副作用），Symbol 用 ref:a_q.shape 与 ref:d.shape 做属性引用且目标都在同一契约内，Tolerance 的来源记录自带限制说明。Design 三区（第 83-120 行）仍是 starter 骨架，这在 P2 属允许状态，不构成独立理解上的缺项。

conclusions.subject: document_layering
conclusions.text: 分层正确，没有下层补入或改写上层决定。Contract 保持任务层：Algorithm_requirement 里没有出现 tile、flag、warp、kernel 名或分支名，k%128==0、contiguous/CUDA、dtype 与 scale shape 匹配、五个指针 16B 对齐、E/M/N/K>0、n%256==0、group_count<=256 这些实现侧限制被明确留在 dispatch 的“来源限制（不是 Contract 要求）”里，没有被升级成算法前提；scale 的 2 的幂值域与“padding 行无数值契约”则确有外部依据（input.py 的编码器与 observable_inputs、metadata 的 region），写在 Contract 是正确的。配置选择没有留在 YAML：两级几何路由、g_group 的 min 选择式、各实验臂开关都在目录，草案还显式要求 P3 为 root 固定一个具体 g_group 值并把规则记在目录，符合“不以开关、枚举、选择公式、查表或自然语言选路留在 YAML”。Hardware_specification 除 Execution 的最小登记外原样保留 starter 占位（Device/Architecture/Feature.mechanism/Stack/Wiki），Execution 四项给出了下游 Storage.location 需要的 register/smem/tmem 及其所属范围，摘要里的固定来源说明属 P1 §3 允许的“保留每项来源依据”，且没有把 256 线程、148 SM 或 232,448 B 这类单次 launch 配置写成设备上限，故不需回 P1。目录也没有覆盖 YAML：变体条目反复声明“精确参数与 when 以 YAML 为准”“路由是选择规则，按规范不写进任何 YAML”“条目的排列和引用不产生 patch 应用顺序”；本轮新增的 DCS/PKELECT 说明也明确写成“不是 root 写回的差额”“默认关闭”，没有把非默认臂的行为当成基线定义。

conclusions.subject: document_consistency
conclusions.text: 通过。上轮标记的四处不一致已全部按源码修正，且我逐一回到 kernel.cu 复核了新写入的行号引用，全部准确：(1) DCS——来源限制第 4 条现与 SF_PF 并列登记“所选构建中无使用点”，写明唯一使用点在 #if FMGGM_EDR 块内（2485-2491）、root 实际走的 DINTER store pass（2400-2418）与非 DINTER 普通 store（2668-2688）都是裸 *dst = val；「输出写回代理」的差异句改成明确否定“不是 root 写回的差额”；「缓存与预取提示」删去 DCS 并把“值相同、只改缓存行为”的归类收窄到 TCP/LEVICT/PROMO/BPF 四项载入侧提示，三处口径一致。(2) TMA_STORE——条件与依据改成按源码分三类：DINTER 与 TJEB 由自动关闭 guard 排除（319-323、605-608 条件列表都含 TMA_STORE）、EDR 无 guard 而是路径优先（EDR 块 2428-2496 自带 store，#else 侧 2655-2666 不进入）、J0LB 未被任何 guard 排除且其 taddr/到达分支 2591-2653 与 TMA_STORE store 分支是同一 for-si 循环内顺序两段可同时编译（tma_stage 双缓冲轮转 2690 为该组合的联动），与我核对的 562-576 关闭条件与两处 #error 完全一致。(3) MCAST——互斥关系按两条 guard 分开归属：自身 #error（590-593）要求 DUALN && N_B==2 && STAIL 并与 BK256/BMERGE/LDGSF/J0LA 互斥、MCAST=3 另有死锁 #error（602-604）；EBOX/EDR/LDBATCH/DRAIN2 等属 DROUTE 那条 guard（631-638），并明确 BMV=128 且 DROUTE=0 时 MCAST 与 EBOX/EDR/LDBATCH 并不被拒绝。(4) PKELECT——已补入默认关闭臂清单，主要机制的 full 计数处加了交叉提示，并新增独立局部条目「SF 打包到达规则」，其基线（65 = 1 expect_tx + warp2/warp3 各 32 lane、per-lane fence.proxy.async，引 1455/1918）、差额（syncwarp + 选举 lane 到达、count 3 = 1 expect_tx + 2 选举 lane，引 1914-1917/1455）与依据（默认关闭、arm-b 血统已验证、本树无实测结论）与 kernel.cu 529-535、1455、1912-1919 逐字对应。此外 worker 主动修正了两处相邻的不准确表述：TJEB 不再被笼统归入“互相 #error”而是正确区分为 #undef 自动关闭（605-608），PDL 不再与 EPAD/EWSLEEP/NKBH 一起归为“值相同提示”而是说明它改的是启动属性与写回 role 的前缀等待、依据是前驱只写 d（441-446、2234-2238）。草案整体自洽性我另行复核：默认宏清单、十五条变体记录的定级、固定用例的路由归属、smem/TMEM 尺寸之间互相吻合，我按同一套常量重算十个用例归属与两条路由 sizeof 都对得上；对改变提交、成员、物化与事件存在性的情形分别贯通（全空输入写成“有启动与早退事件、没有计算工作”，死半 tile 写成写回侧在等 tmem_full 之前 continue，缓存命中写成只省描述符编码与结构体填充、不省任何设备工作、masked_m 内容始终按次在设备读取），没有把未提交、没有工作与已执行动作的 no-op 混为一谈。

conclusions.subject: document_relevance
conclusions.text: 内容必要性合格，没有应删的过程状态，也没有把研究取舍当无关过程删掉。保留下来的都是设计重点与必要理由：主要机制段只写计算/输出形成/工作分配/协作与寿命的实质决定；十五条变体记录各自给出基线对象、差异与联动、条件与依据，其中的实测数字（E70/E71/E101b/E104/E117/E119/E121、exp7/exp8/exp9、case 级百分比）都是该臂被保留或被否决的判据，属规范允许的来源事实与研究取舍，不是历史批准或重复决定；来源限制七条是影响理解的必要条件（尤其两个无使用点的宏、n%256 假定、groups<=256、UE8M0 只在 2 的幂下无损、host 缓存不省设备工作），保留正确；EXPER/MTR/MTRE 被明确标为诊断臂且“不构成设计，只在需要解释源码注释里的数字时引用”，避免了把打点当机制。本轮新增的 PKELECT 条目不是冗余：它改动的是 root 的一项主要协作事实（full 的计数与到达者），并写明“计数与到达点必须同时改，否则 full 永不满足或提前满足”这一必要联动，属于必须保留的动作契约信息；同时它没有把默认关闭臂的行为混入基线定义。草案没有写入退修记录、待办清单或版本历史，“待 P3/P4 落实的线索”是本阶段规定的未知边界登记位置而非待办泄漏；短文本也没有复述可见字段或琐碎步骤，命名（宽激活 tile、解码 tile、几何路由、尾波拆分开关、激活取数范围阶梯、SF 交付路径、SF 打包到达规则、输出写回代理、权重请求合并、集群权重多播与对等中继）清楚常见、无生僻自造缩写，新旧两条 SF 相关条目职责分明不重复。目录格式符合最小格式：范围与完整设计齐备，十五条变体标题都用全角括号标明（参数）/（局部）/（组合）且三个信息项齐全，没有空小节。
